title: Patient operations platform
summary: Consolidating patient operations across 12 clinics. Procurement is reviewing the annual proposal; a security review remains open.

interactions.title: Discovery: security before scale
interactions.content: Priya said Aster Health needs India-only data residency and SSO before deploying across 12 clinics. Their current vendor could not provide an audit trail. She prefers a concise written security checklist rather than a long slide deck.

interactions.title: Demo with the clinical operations team
interactions.content: The operations team liked the workflow demo. Priya requested a two-clinic pilot before rollout. IT lead Rohan must approve SSO and the data residency architecture. No security documents have been sent yet.

interactions.title: Procurement asks about annual pricing
interactions.content: Priya said the $72,000 annual proposal is within budget if the pilot succeeds. Procurement wants a 30-day pilot acceptance plan. She asked us not to assume that budget approval means security approval.

interactions.title: Final review needs the original security context
interactions.content: Priya is concerned that the proposal still does not address the requirements discussed in August. Rohan will join the next review. She asked for the security checklist and a clear owner for the pilot before discussing signature dates.

title: Fleet visibility rollout
summary: Evaluating shipment visibility for 300 vehicles. Integration reliability and driver connectivity are key to the pilot decision.

interactions.title: Discovery: patchy connectivity
interactions.content: Arjun requires offline capture because drivers lose connectivity on rural routes. Northstar uses SAP and needs shipment events synced through an API. Arjun prefers technical documentation before a demo.

interactions.title: Pilot success criteria
interactions.content: Arjun requested a 20-vehicle pilot with event delivery measured after devices reconnect. He is comparing RoutePulse. The finance team is concerned about per-vehicle price increases after the pilot.

interactions.title: Reconnect behavior still unproven
interactions.content: Arjun said the online demo was useful but did not prove the rural-route requirement. He wants a live offline-to-online test and a written year-two pricing cap before approving the pilot.

title: Customer support workspace
summary: Unifying support across 40 stores. A seasonal launch creates a tight migration window and training constraints.

interactions.title: Holiday launch constraints
interactions.content: Sana needs the support workspace live before November 1. Store agents need Hindi and Telugu training. The existing ticket history must migrate without losing customer conversations.

interactions.title: Budget and migration review
interactions.content: Sana confirmed a $36,000 annual budget. The CFO needs migration costs itemized separately. Sana prefers short video walkthroughs and requires a named escalation contact during launch week.

interactions.title: Training plan missing from proposal
interactions.content: Sana is concerned that the proposal only includes English onboarding. She asked us to revisit the language requirements from discovery and confirm whether migration can finish before the seasonal launch.
